title: Copilot 365 Essentials
summary: Copilot 365 Essentials is a vendor certification offered by CompTIA. This independent study guide covers all 1 objective domains: Objectives. Each domain is broken into 7 lessons in total, and every lesson has a MEDIUM and a HARD scenario exam. The exams use realistic workplace situations rather than recall questions, so you practise applying each objective the way the job asks for it.
attributionNote: CompTIA certification content is an independent study guide written for Cyber Pulse Academy and is not affiliated with or endorsed by CompTIA.
